CustomField.description: Which edition the administrator chose in the Setup Assistant's first step: Standard (the Standard Edition, Core alone) or Nonprofit (the Nonprofit Edition, Core with Giving). Empty until chosen. Held as text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist (ADR-0019). Installs and removes nothing; only Nonprofit shows the nonprofit modules (ADR-0124).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Standard for the Standard Edition, Nonprofit for the Nonprofit Edition, exactly as written. Chosen once in the Setup Assistant; see the admin guide page Editions before changing it.
CustomField.label: Edition
